_comment: Scoring rules for the DEMO checklist only. These numbers are illustrative and do not represent any real audit methodology.

d3._mode_options: zero_zone_share — a D3 finding burns the whole share of its own zone; zero_total — any D3 zeroes the entire audit.
d3._skip_comment: true — D1/D2 findings in a zone that already has a D3 still appear in the report, but do not reduce the score again (the zone is already lost). false — they would be subtracted on top.

_cap_comment: true — total deductions in one zone cannot exceed that zone's share (e.g. many D1 findings in a 20%-share zone cost at most 20%, not more). false — deductions simply add up.

grades._logic: Checked strictly in this order; the first matching rule wins.

deadlines._comment: The remediation deadline comes from the days column in checklist.csv. This section is a ceiling by severity: the deadline can never exceed the value given here. D3 is always immediate.

_plan_due_comment: The action-plan due date in the letter is the report date plus this many days.
